statements.text: A non-contact force is a force which acts at a distance without any physical contact between bodies, so it acts even if the objects involved are not touching.
A non-contact force is also termed as an action at a distance force.

Examples of non-contact forces include gravitational force (such as the force experienced by the moon because of Earth), electrostatic force (such as the attractive force between a positively charged nucleus and a negatively charged electron), and magnetic force (such as the repulsive force between two North poles of magnets).
